title: Photography
text: I’m a recreational photographer of 5+ years. I use an old Nikon D3200 and with a 55-210mm lens. I did sports photography for my high school Athletics Department, in particular the Cross Country + Track and Field teams. Now, I do mostly events and nature. All photos are for personal, non-commercial use only and are not monetized in any way.

title: SSMU Research Committee
text:
This page contains info for the Research Committee of the Duke Statistical Science Majors Union (SSMU). We run a seminar series featuring researchers doing stats-related work in academia and industry. We also run an undergrad reading group on modern theory/methods in statistics and ML.
We are actively looking for undergrads to join our committee! You need not be a Stats major (I’m not). If interested, email me at xiran.wang at duke dot edu. There is a one-question application.

title: SSMU Research Committee
text:
Reading Group
We meet biweekly on Fridays, 5-6pm in Perkins Link Group Study 1. At each meeting, someone presents on a manuscript/excerpt they read, and we discuss. If you’re an undergrad interested in theory/methods in stats/ML, feel free to show up! No registration or prerequisites required, but do email me beforehand.

I’m an undergrad at Duke University studying Physics and Mathematics, with a minor in Statistical Science. I’m broadly interested in data-driven modeling and scientific machine learning theory/methods for (bio)physics applications. Specifics include:

Learning dynamical systems
Physics-informed architectures
Applications in microbiology, public health, quantum systems.

I’m also curious about graph methods, topological/geometric data analysis, and generative modeling. I was born in Beijing, China and live in Cary, NC. My given name is Xiran; I go by Derek.
I’ve put some hand-written lecture notes and notes on select topics here.



As part of the Lingchong You Lab, I work with VAE-MLP models for time-series parameter estimation on bacterial growth curves, specifically targeting chaotic ODE systems.
As part of the Liberata Algorithms Team, I’m developing graph-based metrics/algorithms for a new academic publishing system based on continuous authorship shares.
In Summer 2025, I was an AI R&D intern at Lenovo with the Cloud Service Providers, where I assembled an AI cluster testbed and looked at network optimization schemes.



I lead the Research Committee for the Statistical Science Majors Union (SSMU), where I’m organizing a seminar series and reading group on theory/methods in modern statistics. More here.
I’m an avid graphic designer of 7+ years, primarily via Photoshop and (more recently) Figma. I serve as a co-director of HackDuke, where I lead the Design Team. I also design for the Duke Math Union, in particular for the annual Duke Math Meet. See some past works here.
I’m also a recreational photographer. I’ve done sports photography in the past; now I do mostly events and nature. See some photos here.
